decisions.reason: The air quality sensor builds on the firm's existing sensing and modular electronics knowledge, enabling it to interpret feedback and improve the module.
As a direct successor to an existing analog input module, it is tightly related to in-house analog and firmware expertise, giving high absorptive capacity.
The CAN bus interface fits the firm's connectivity and communication expertise, allowing it to assimilate protocol feedback and update firmware.
The CO2 sensor module extends the firm's established environmental sensing capabilities, so the firm can learn from early results and refine it.
